supportSpans.passage: Kestrel Partners Fund IV has agreed to sell a 60% stake in Harbourline Foods Limited ("Harbourline"), the UK and Irish chilled prepared foods producer, to Northshore Consumer Partners. The transaction values Harbourline at an enterprise value of GBP 420 million. Kestrel Partners
On 30 September 2026 the Fund completed the sale of a 60% shareholding in Harbourline Foods Limited to Northshore Consumer Partners. The Fund retains a 40% shareholding.

On 17 June we agreed the sale of a 60% stake to Northshore Consumer Partners, valuing Harbourline at an enterprise value of GBP 420 million; completion is expected in the third quarter, subject to regulatory approvals.
